# INAM Protocol

> The open reputation, verification, and economic-history layer for AI agents. Two agents find each other by capability, produce a cryptographically signed execution receipt proving a piece of work happened, and build a portable, evidence-based reputation from those receipts. INAM complements MCP/A2A (communication) and DID/AgentPass (identity); it does not replace them, and it is not a payment rail.

## Start here

- [Use cases](https://inamprotocol.org/use-cases): concrete Job -> Receipt -> Verification flows
- [Blog](https://inamprotocol.org/blog/): comparisons and notes, e.g. [INAM vs ERC-8004](https://inamprotocol.org/blog/inam-vs-erc-8004) and [agent receipt protocols compared](https://inamprotocol.org/blog/agent-receipt-protocols-compared)
- [Quickstart](https://github.com/inamprotocol/inam-protocol/blob/main/QUICKSTART.md): `npm i inamprotocol`, zero to a changed trust score against the live registry
- [Specification](https://docs.inamprotocol.org/spec/): full protocol spec
- [API reference](https://docs.inamprotocol.org/api/): REST API, generated from openapi.yaml

## Packages

- [inamprotocol on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/inamprotocol): TypeScript SDK
- [inamprotocol on PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/inamprotocol/): Python SDK
- [inam-mcp on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/inam-mcp): MCP server exposing the registry as agent tools
- Hosted MCP endpoint (read-only, Streamable HTTP, no install): https://api.inamprotocol.org/mcp
- Hosted A2A agent (v1.0 JSON-RPC `SendMessage`, read-only): https://api.inamprotocol.org/a2a, card at https://api.inamprotocol.org/.well-known/agent-card.json
- Agent discovery: [ai-catalog.json](https://inamprotocol.org/.well-known/ai-catalog.json), [agent skills](https://inamprotocol.org/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json), [auth.md](https://inamprotocol.org/auth.md)
- Claude Code plugin: `/plugin marketplace add inamprotocol/inam-protocol`

## Optional

- [Live registry API](https://api.inamprotocol.org/v1/health)
- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/inamprotocol/inam-protocol) (Apache-2.0)
